newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - HERMIS BANK MOST ACTIVE CM STOCK LAST WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - HERMIS BANK MOST ACTIVE CM STOCK LAST WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Monday that Hermis Bank's shares were the most active group A stock on the central market of the Vilnius bourse last week in trade of 576,000 litas.
Hermis was followed by Alytaus Textile with turnover of 356,000 litas and pharmaceuticals producer Sema which saw 241,000 litas worth of its shares change hands on the central market last week.

Banks were the most active group A stocks in block trades last week. Siauliu Bank saw block trades worth 1.035 million litas, Hermis Bank traded 858,000 litas in block trades and Vilniaus Bank's block turnover was 812,500 litas.
The biggest deal in bloc trades was registered by current list company Baltik Vairas, which registered a trade of 13.48 million litas.
Cardboard maker Medienos Plaushas was the biggest gainer from the A list last week, rising 3.73 percent to 12.5 litas.
It was followed by TV tubes producer Ekranas and Hermis Bank, which rose 3.45 percent to 5.4 litas and 2.8 percent to 180.00 litas respectively last week.
The week's A group losers included Krekenavos Agrocompany, which fell 38.57 percent to 0.43 litas.
Dirbtinis Pluoshtas saw its shares decrease by 37.21 percent to 0.54 litas last week.
